title: Plamenix plugin manifest
description: Schema for `manifest.toml` shipped inside a Plamenix plugin bundle. Mirrors the Rust types in `plamenix_plugin_host::manifest::Manifest`. See `plamenix/docs/plugin-manifest.md` for the prose spec.

id.description: Reverse-DNS identifier (e.g. `dev.plamenix.hello`). Must be unique across the ecosystem.

name.description: Human-readable plugin name shown in the plugin manager UI.

plamenix_min_version.description: SemVer requirement string for the host (e.g. `>=1.0.0-beta`, `^1.2`, `*`). Pre-release host versions require an explicit pre-release lower bound to match.

plugin_api.description: WIT package version the plugin targets. Currently always `1.0` until the WIT contract bumps.

description.description: Optional one-line description shown in the plugin manager UI.

required.description: Capabilities the plugin cannot operate without. The host refuses to honour calls that need these until the user grants them.

optional.description: Capabilities the plugin would like but can run without. Surfaced as an opt-in prompt.

permission.description: Dotted capability string. See `plamenix/docs/capability-model.md` for the grammar. Wildcards are deliberately not supported.

anyOf.description: Scoped DB read against a specific table.
Scoped DB write against a specific table.
Scoped DDL against a specific table.
HTTPS scoped to a particular host.
Filesystem read in a whitelisted logical directory.
Filesystem write in a whitelisted logical directory.

entry_points.description: Bundle-relative paths to plugin halves. At least one of `wasm`, `ui`, or `subprocess` must be present. When `runtime.requires_subprocess` is true, `subprocess` is required.

wasm.description: Path to the WASM Component Model component file.

ui.description: Path to the ESM module exporting React contributions.

subprocess.description: Path to the native executable for subprocess-mode plugins.

requires_subprocess.description: When true, the plugin runs outside the WASM sandbox via the subprocess activator. Requires `runtime.subprocess` in `permissions.required` and a `subprocess` entry point.

contributions.description: Declarative UI contributions surfaced without needing to run the plugin. The plugin's runtime half may augment them with state.

id.description: Stable identifier used by the host to route panel clicks to the plugin.

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the sidebar.

icon.description: Optional Lucide-react icon name. Unknown names fall back to a default in the host.
